points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers and amounts read correctly, with the currency beside the right figure?
Are the field labels on the right edge, above or beside their inputs?
Does typed-looking text in the fields start from the right?
Does the emirate picker show Dubai with its arrow on the left side?
Does the phone example 050 123 4567 stay left to right and unscrambled?
Are the building, street, area and Makani fields all there and clearly labelled?
Is the Save address button full width and easy to spot?
